# What vim's window layout does, measured 2026-09-04 against
# /opt/homebrew/bin/vim, VIM 9.2 patches 1-321, through
#
#   vim --clean -i NONE --not-a-term -n -S probe.vim -s KEYS f.txt
#
# with ":set lines=24 columns=80 ea nosb nospr" first, so every case starts
# from one 23-row 80-column window on a 24-row screen with the command line
# taking the last row, and 'laststatus' 1, which means the only window of a tab
# has no status line and every window of a split one does.
#
# One vim per case. Running them in one session does not work: ":only" on a
# single window prints "Already only one window", which is a message, and the
# hit-enter prompt behind it eats the next few keystrokes and quietly shifts
# everything after it.
#
# Each row is a tab-separated pair of the commands and the windows they leave,
# in vim's own window order, each written
#
#   row,col,height,width
#
# from win_screenpos(), winheight() and winwidth(), with a "*" on the current
# one. row and col are 1-based screen cells and height and width are the text
# area, so a window with a status line under it occupies height+1 rows and one
# with a separator beside it occupies width+1 columns.
#
# internal/window/layout_test.go replays every row.
:sp	1,1,11,80* 13,1,10,80
:sp :sp	1,1,7,80* 9,1,7,80 17,1,6,80
:sp :sp :sp	1,1,5,80* 7,1,5,80 13,1,5,80 19,1,4,80
:sp :sp :sp :sp	1,1,4,80* 6,1,4,80 11,1,3,80 15,1,4,80 20,1,3,80
:vs	1,1,22,40* 1,42,22,39
:vs :vs	1,1,22,26* 1,28,22,26 1,55,22,26
:vs :vs :vs	1,1,22,20* 1,22,22,19 1,42,22,19 1,62,22,19
:vs :sp	1,1,11,40* 13,1,10,40 1,42,22,39
:sp :vs	1,1,11,40* 1,42,11,39 13,1,10,80
sb :sp	1,1,10,80 12,1,11,80*
spr :vs	1,1,22,39 1,41,22,40*
:5sp	1,1,5,80* 7,1,16,80
:30vs	1,1,22,30* 1,32,22,49
noea :sp :sp	1,1,5,80* 7,1,5,80 13,1,10,80
:sp :sp <C-W>+	1,1,8,80* 10,1,6,80 17,1,6,80
:sp :sp 3<C-W>+	1,1,10,80* 12,1,4,80 17,1,6,80
:sp :sp <C-W>-	1,1,6,80* 8,1,8,80 17,1,6,80
:sp :sp <C-W>_	1,1,18,80* 20,1,1,80 22,1,1,80
:sp :sp <C-W>_ <C-W>=	1,1,7,80* 9,1,7,80 17,1,6,80
:sp :sp 10<C-W>_	1,1,10,80* 12,1,4,80 17,1,6,80
:vs 5<C-W>>	1,1,22,45* 1,47,22,34
:vs 5<C-W><	1,1,22,35* 1,37,22,44
:vs <C-W>|	1,1,22,78* 1,80,22,1
:sp :sp :q	1,1,11,80* 13,1,10,80
:vs :sp :q	1,1,22,40* 1,42,22,39
:sp :vs :only	1,1,23,80*
:sp :sp <C-W>j	1,1,7,80 9,1,7,80* 17,1,6,80
:sp :sp <C-W>b	1,1,7,80 9,1,7,80 17,1,6,80*
:sp :sp <C-W>t	1,1,7,80* 9,1,7,80 17,1,6,80
:sp :sp <C-W>w	1,1,7,80 9,1,7,80* 17,1,6,80
:sp :sp 3<C-W>w	1,1,7,80 9,1,7,80 17,1,6,80*
:sp :sp <C-W>W	1,1,7,80 9,1,7,80 17,1,6,80*
:vs :sp <C-W>l	1,1,11,40 13,1,10,40 1,42,22,39*
:vs :sp <C-W>l <C-W>h	1,1,11,40* 13,1,10,40 1,42,22,39
:sp :sp <C-W>j <C-W>p	1,1,7,80* 9,1,7,80 17,1,6,80
:sp :sp <C-W>j <C-W>k	1,1,7,80* 9,1,7,80 17,1,6,80
:vs :sp <C-W>l <C-W>j	1,1,11,40 13,1,10,40 1,42,22,39*
:sp :vs :q	1,1,11,80* 13,1,10,80
:vs :vs :q	1,1,22,40* 1,42,22,39
:sp :sp <C-W>_ <C-W>x	1,1,1,80* 3,1,18,80 22,1,1,80
:sp :sp <C-W>_ <C-W>r	1,1,1,80 3,1,18,80* 22,1,1,80
